$comment: Upstream repos watched by .github/workflows/fork-observation.yml (weekly, read-only). The digest is published as a workflow artifact + step summary — CI never pushes. All repos are public, fetched with the workflow GITHUB_TOKEN via plain REST. Design: docs/architecture/FORK_OBSERVATION.md.

repos.because: Upstream of the HELIOS actions-runner-controller fork (self-hosted runner scale sets — GITHUB_ECOSYSTEM_DESIGN.md); releases drive controller/chart upgrades for the PR5 fleet bring-up.
RAG reference implementation tracked for the PR3 Foundry retrieval work (AI Search connection, file search patterns).
Windows App SDK releases gate the HELIOS.Shell dependency pin (src/gui, WinUI 3 shell) and the PR6 net10 platform upgrade.

Upstream of the Yolkster64/hermes-agent-github fork: the Hermes CLI the fleet lanes spawn (`hermes -p <assignee> chat -q <prompt>`) and the kanban verbs the fleet contract assumes (claim/complete/block/swarm/daemon) ship here; installer and auth changes land in its releases first (HERMES_FLEET_AND_XCORE.md).

Linear's SDK monorepo (Yolkster64/linear is a fork): the GraphQL mutations linear-sync.yml hand-rolls are defined against its schema, so schema and SDK releases are the early warning for the sync lane.
The MCP SDK behind src/mcp/HELIOS.Mcp; protocol changes and breaking SDK releases land here first.
